BiblicalUsage: Zowb is a discharge or issue of the body, and Leviticus 15 builds a whole chapter of law around it. The discharge made a person unclean until evening, with washings and offerings to follow, and the law covers both men and women. It is one of the laws that taught Israel that uncleanness was real, and that cleanness had to be restored.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe these laws taught Israel — and teach me — that God cares about the body as well as the heart, and that He provided a way back to cleanness.
